title: Bad News :(
content: Unfortunately, the mod I used to get my skin and cape in Minecraft 1.2.5 stopped working because my graphics card driver no longer supports the OpenGL used in such an old version of the game, and that ended up breaking the whole thing :( including my world.

title: My eternal world!
content: I started this world not long ago, but I'm already making significant progress. Here’s a screenshot to show how things are going and that I’m already fully geared up in iron; I also have a diamond pickaxe. I’m really happy to be creating something cool without a care in the world!
